title: AOSSIE MCP catalog
description: The static document an AOSSIE MCP server reads. Publish it to GitHub Pages; the npm package fetches it at runtime. Mirror of src/core/schemas.ts — keep the two in step.

version.description: Contract version. Bump only for breaking shape changes; the server refuses versions it cannot read.

generatedAt.description: When the builder produced this document. Lets callers judge staleness.

categories.description: The vocabulary the search tool filters on. Keep it small — a dozen categories a model can hold in mind beats a hundred it cannot.

id.description: Stable and URL-safe. Changing an id breaks anything that cached it.

summary.description: One sentence. Returned by search, so it is the field a model uses to choose — write it for that reader.

content.description: Full body. Returned only by the get tool, never by search.
